correctness.rationale: Independent stdlib replay confirms every essential computation. (1) Monotone-triangle generator: small counts 1,2,7,42 validated; live n=7 re-enumeration gives 218348 triangles to 2630 symmetric ASMs in about 1.9s, exactly matching committed J7_enum.json (116 cells, sum 2630). Row and column sums validated on the fly. (2) Statistics: per-object direct I=sum Aij*Aiprimejprime and M=N_-1 agree with structural I=2P+(7-S)/2, M=R+(S-7)/2 on all 2630 DSASM(7) (checked 2630, bad 0). DRAFT row tables and M/I marginals recomputed exactly from joint list. (3) Totals: BFK numDSASM Pfaffian re-implemented independently; matching-sum vs Bareiss-det sqrt agree and equal 1,2,5,16,67,368,2630,24376,293770,4610624 for n=1..10 (P7=2630). Abs-det sign handling is sound because Pf^2=det and sign is fixed by matching-sum route. (4) Refined agreement: Xprs7_full.json has 132 terms, sum 2630, all coefficients nonnegative, S-support {1,3,5,7} (odd as required); projection (P,R,S)->(I,M) equals J7 cell-for-cell; PRS7_enum.json (132 entries, sum 2630) projects identically and equals Xprs as (P,R,S) multiset. Forward xprs7_full.py rerun reproduces terms=132 total=2630 with identical marginals. (5) Witnesses: all 6 matrices in witnesses.json independently verified as ASMs, symmetric, with (I,M) matching keys: (0,0) identity, (21,0) anti-identity, (6,9) dense max-M, plus (8,6),(18,0),(19,0). (6) Lemma: classical Stembridge/Okada antisymmetrizer-to-Pfaffian reduction; proof sketch is standard tail-swap involution, honestly scoped as instantiation plus machine check not invention. Artifact lemma_check.py prints LEMMA_CHECK_OK; auditor probes also give equality. Limitations honestly stated: Xprs formula used as stated (BFK Sec.10 proofs omitted); Pfaffian route is exact evaluation plus agreement, not a re-proof of BFK six-vertex argument.

originality.rationale: Three-form fused retrieval (literal J7, equivalent BFK-Xbar/Stembridge-LGV encodings, dominance/database coverage) in one scope_literature_search call (SerpBase plus Crossref fusion; OpenAlex 0 hits but status ok; partial=false) plus direct fetches of BFK abstract/ToC, OEIS A005163 text, OEIS A005156, FindStat. Nearest prior is BFK arXiv:2309.08446 v2: Pfaffian for totals plus (R,S,T) and Sec.10 generalized Xbar Pfaffian equations, but no evaluated order-7 (I,M) or (P,R,S) table. OEIS and FindStat hold only totals and small-order data. Other-class refined and product results (ordinary-ASM, VSASM, DASASM, OSASM) are materially different objects and do not imply the DSASM-restricted law. Decisive checks (equivalent_formulations, broader_coverage, exact_database_or_table, claim_vs_prior_implication) each tested adversarially; none covers the 116-cell J7, 132-term Xprs projection, marginals, or witnesses. Lemma is explicitly claimed only as classical Stembridge instantiation plus check, so its textbook status does not defeat J7 novelty.

value.rationale: TARGET route judged against admitted target. Result is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: joint (Robbins-Rumsey inversion I, N_-1 count M) distribution over DSASM(7), the last major ASM symmetry class without a product formula (FindStat/BFK/OEIS gap pre-dates computation). Object (DSASM order 7, 2630 matrices) and statistics (I,M via standard BFK relations to P,R,S) were motivated before computation to constrain the open formula search and serve square-ice and representation-theory uses. Value is not known or mechanically implied: totals Pfaffian does not determine joint law; extraction required nontrivial signed evaluation plus dual-route enumeration with per-object agreement. Future researcher can reasonably need the precise fact: 116-cell J7, M-marginal {0:232,1:350,2:672,3:538,4:482,5:217,6:104,7:28,8:6,9:1}, I-marginal, 132-term nonnegative (P,R,S) refinement, extremal witnesses (identity (0,0), anti-identity (21,0), dense (6,9) with 9 minus-ones). Not a textbook restatement, mere parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: census is complete over natural scope, certified by two independent routes, with interpretation. Lemma instantiation accompanies rather than carries the headline. Passes the narrow-exact-datum standard.

broader_coverage.evidence: BFK gives totals and (R,S,T)/generalized Pfaffians with no order-7 refined coefficients listed. DASASM odd product, VSASM refined, ordinary-ASM multiply-refined, OSASM odd product cover different symmetry classes by definition. broader_coverage.reasoning: A general Pfaffian formula determining J7 in principle does not exhaustively cover it as a published special case. Extraction at n=7 needs exact trivariate series, prefactor sign resolution, and 6x6 Pfaffian -- new computation, not a listed read-off. Different-class theorems do not restrict to transpose-symmetric matrices.
